messages:
tara: quick heads-up 2m ago we enabled strict fncall validation on canary-eu and rejects jumped to ~5.8% (baseline ~0.3%). not convinced it's just model input drift.

time nate: yikes. link + top reject examples? is this rejects vs reroutes vs degen path?

li: chart: https://console.redwood.internal/d/validators/eu-canary?panel=fncall_rejects. metric is validator.rejects and there's a matching uptick in fallback->degen transfers. sample payload from trace: 
```json
{\"tool_response\": [\"ok\", \"done\"], \"validation_error\": \"expected object for tool_response, got array\"}
```

maria: that pattern matches an older adapter shim we shipped to some customers (it returns arrays for simple responses).

validation-bot: Canary 'strict-validate-canary-eu' AUTO-PAUSE: reject_rate > 2.5% for 3/5 mins. rollout paused.

tara: two blocking asks before unpause: (1) show a reject_reason histogram in the rollout panel with human labels (not raw validator codes), and (2) make billing attribution explicit in the UI (are rejects billed to original route or final routed path?).

nate: implementation notes: pipeline logs have validator.code but no human mapping; sampling for reject traces is 1/100 currently. suggest bump to 1/10 for canary for 1 hour to gather examples.

li: infra plan: add a normalization step that maps known adapter mismatch patterns to canonical reasons (e.g. TOOL_SHAPE_ARRAY_INSTEAD_OF_OBJ). will ship behind feature flag. also can add header X-Validate-Force-Sample to force a trace capture from SDKs.

maria: UX tweak: in rollout detail show two numbers: "rejects (original route_id)" and "rejects (post-validate fallback)". that will make it obvious if it's a validator issue vs routing/fallback behavior.

validation-bot: Note: logs will now emit original_route_id + final_route_tag in the validation stream for easier attribution (if enabled).

tara: I'll open PLAT-3509: "canary-eu strict-validate follow-up: reject_reason histogram + sampled trace links + billing attribution flag". assign @li @nate @maria. acceptance: histogram with human labels + links to top-N sampled traces, side-by-side reject counters, and an explicit billing flag in rollout UI showing whether rejects are billable.

nate: i'll prototype the histogram widget today using diag-panel. low-risk change.

li: i'll implement the normalizer and sampling header behind a feature flag and test on canary slice. will emit canonical reject_reason and original_route_id in logs.

maria: tagging @support for customer comms prep in case we unpause and see residual rejects.

tara: TL;DR: keep canary paused until histogram + trace links + billing attribution are live. sync in 20 mins in #eng-platform if available. :thumbsup:
